extracted.name: How to cook brown rice
extracted.description: Follow our recipe for achieving perfectly cooked brown rice every time. With our expert tips, you can avoid chalky undercooked grains or squishy overcooked mush.
ingredient_lines: You will need a medium-sized saucepan with a well-fitting lid
instruction_lines: Put the rice in a saucepan and pour over 500ml water. Bring to a rolling boil and then reduce the heat to a gentle simmer.
Cook for 30 mins, then turn off the heat.
Quickly cover with a lid and leave tightly covered for another 5-10 mins to absorb any remaining water.
Serve immediately with a stew or curry, fish, chicken or tofu.
